source: Package 1 final phone walkthrough and checks (17.11.2026). Not from package 1 (main df96d68 shows the same), or accepted there. Candidates for package 2; check each again before fixing.

items.text: The Kaution card hint 'offset in Settlements with the NK-Abrechnung' breaks as 'NK-' / 'Abrechnung' at 390 px (move-out form, settled card).
The move-out form shows the Soll twice: the hint 'Soll: 2.400,00 € · Fest seit Einzug' and the editable 'Kaution Soll 2.400,00'. The hint is German ('Fest seit Einzug') inside the English card.

The sheet header of a moved-out tenant reads 'Lima · 24 m² · NK 01.01.2026–31.12.2026 · moved out' (the house's NK year) while the tenant's own period in the calculation, list and letter is 01.01.2026–30.09.2026.

In the pop-up of a former tenant with everything closed (ALL DONE), the enabled Archive button keeps the faint grey text colour of the disabled one (rgb 200,191,176), so it looks unavailable although it works.

After Mark as sent the Money step appears 0.7 s after the tap (5.6 s on a slow network) and pushes the Calculation down 137 px; after Received on a slow network the sheet shrinks 13 px about 2 s after the tap; after locking the house costs on a slow network the cost cards shift 24–36 px. No flashing; expected state changes, but visible jumps.

After a result equal to the held part is settled, Rentals' 'Kaution held back' reads 'nothing to transfer' and its Money line adds the date, while Casa reads 'nothing transferred'. Rentals uses the planned-text pattern for every settled result.
When a card Save AND its queued put-back both fail (two connection failures in a row), the Kaution row can stay mixed until the next Save. Main has the same state without any put-back.
Same as K2 rentals-calc-3: the 'on you' Leerstand row still uses the old tenancy dates after the period is changed (seen again in rc3-perfix and rf-p10).
